sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Bhaskar Singh,Sunil Kumar Singh Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Rajesh Kumar Srivastava Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.

1. Heard Sri Bhaskar Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri Gaurav Srivastava holding brief of Sri Rajesh Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Virendra Kumar Pal,
learned A.G.A for the State respondents.

2. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 17.04.2023, registered as Case Crime No. 0191 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 406, 328, 354, 354-B, 120B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Sadar Bazar, District Agra.

Further prayer has been made not to Rahul And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194457517/
1 arrest the petitioners in the aforesaid case.

entities.text: Rahul And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Vide order dated 15.05.2023 the matter was referred to Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
As per mediation centre report the petitioners have not come forward to deposit the amount as directed by this Court.

4. Learned counsel for the informant informed that the informant has appeared before the mediation centre on two dates but the petitioners have not appeared and therefore, it is clearly reflected that intention of the petitioners is not bona fide.
5. Learned AGA opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR, which discloses cognizable offence.
6. Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.

sentences.text: 7. Therefore, the writ petition is dismissed leaving it open for the petitioners to apply before the competent court for anticipatory bail/bail as permissible under law and in accordance with law.
